headline: We are not only a team, but also an institute for learning!
tagline: United by Passion. Driven by Cricket.
metaDescription: UK Bangla Tigers Cricket Club — international T20 cricket since 2020, an institute for learning, with sister franchise Uppsala Tigers in Sweden.
clubIntroLede: A registered cricket club, competing across international tournaments since 2020.

whyChooseUs.title: International Competition
whyChooseUs.body: Competing across the Safari International T20 Cup, Nordic Smash T20 and the Asian Challengers Trophy.

whyChooseUs.title: A Learning Institute
whyChooseUs.body: The club describes itself as not only a team, but an institute for learning.

whyChooseUs.title: A Franchise Network
whyChooseUs.body: One family across multiple nations, alongside sister franchise Uppsala Tigers in Sweden.

whyChooseUs.title: A Registered Club
whyChooseUs.body: Registered as UK Bangla Tigers Cricket Club CIC, originally founded in 2020.
